name: Poulan / McCulloch
label: Poulan / McCulloch
summary: Poulan saws are among the most common budget homeowner saws in US garages, and several appear by name in Oregon's fitment data for its 91-series low-profile chain. McCulloch saws of the same era were built on related platforms, but per-model McCulloch fitments are published here only when traced to a citable source.
